title: Polynomial-Time Padded Pair Emission
statement: For all natural numbers $C$ and $c$, there exist a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet and a natural number $K$ such that, on every input word $x$, the machine outputs the self-delimiting pair encoding of $x$ and the all-ones word of length $C(2^{|x|+1})^c$. On inputs of length $n$, it does so within $K\bigl(n+C(2^{3(n+1)})^c+1\bigr)^{c+2}$ steps.
replaced: For all natural numbers $C$ and $c$ there exist a deterministic machine and a constant $K$ computing, on every input $x$, the pair encoding of $x$ with the all-ones pad of length $C \cdot 2^{(|x|+1)^c}$, within $K\,(n + C\cdot 2^{(3(n+1))^c} + 1)^{c+2}$ steps on inputs of length $n$.
